messages.subject: about N mixture model
parts:
Dear All,

I am new to the R software, especially with unmarked. I have repeated count data (two seasons-pre and post monsoon) to estimate:
1. N estimates for each sites per season (with SE, 95% CI for each site)
2. Abundance model
3. Occupancy model.

Is there any body to help me for this analysis because i need to do this as soon as possible.

Or you can help me by providing steps procedure to conduct independently beginning from the data management to result interpretation.

Hearing response soon from the member of this group.

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] about N mixture model
parts:
Dear Shambhu,
 I'm afraid you're going to have to roll your sleeves up and learn basic data processing and manipulation with R because of course all the unmarked functionality depends on being able to manipulate basic R data structures (e.g., read them into R and so on).  This list is not the right place to begin to learn R. However, I believe there are some helpful online resources for learning R. 
In our Webinar from a couple years ago we have a number of examples of doing analyses:
A 5 hour "introduction to unmarked" Webinar can be found here: http://www.pwrc.usgs.gov/Roylevideo.cfm

Also I recommend consulting the help files for pcount and occu (at the R command prompt:  ?pcount or ?occu).

regards
andy
